prompts.name: arrival
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen story illustration for a 128x64 monochrome submarine game. Fresh original artwork, wide exact 2:1 composition. Deliberate old Macintosh one-bit adventure illustration with chunky pixel/woodcut shapes, not a vector diagram. Establish convincing three-dimensional space through foreground cropping, scale progression, overlapping volumes, one consistent vanishing point and cast/contact shadows. Pure black and white value masses; white lights and lit planes against deep solid black shadows. Selective coarse ordered stipple/hatch ONLY within a few shaded material surfaces, never a global noise veil. Simplify objects so the scene still reads at 128x64; favor broad silhouettes and thick 2-4 low-resolution-pixel structural edges over fine details. No people or human silhouettes, no lettering, labels, UI, border, caption band, watermark, gradients or gray wash. A small cargo submarine arrives at the industrial underwater refuge Benthos with filter supplies. Low camera beside a cropped massive dark dock bollard and beam in the near lower right foreground; dock edge recedes diagonally into the distant right-hand refuge. A recognizable small cylindrical work submarine in THREE QUARTER view occupies left midground, rounded bow aimed toward the berth, visible top and curved hull side, compact conning tower, three broad portholes, two strapped filter cargo boxes. It floats in a spacious black water field. The smaller distant refuge has a few bright dock lamps, a deep lit open berth and receding pilings. A few broad pool-of-light shapes on dock planes, underside shadows, no schematic side elevation. Strong quiet arrival mood.

Low oblique camera looking along a row of three large cylindrical hydroponic glass tanks toward a small rear filter unit and back door. Nearest tank very large and partially cropped at left foreground, clearly elliptical top rim and curved side wall. Hero midground tank centered, strong transparent cylinder outline containing a broad living leafy crop above the rim, descending tangled roots visibly submerged below a crisp waterline. A smaller third tank recedes to rear right. Strip lamps hang overhead in perspective. Broad floor slabs and thick supply pipes recede diagonally toward rear right, with cast shadows and dark contact shadows under the tank bases. These are food-growing tanks in a believable room, not dangling IV stands or diagrams. Preserve large clean lit glass/wall planes and black leaf silhouettes; selective stipple only curved tank side shadow and dark wall corner. Foreground occlusion, clear depth and purposeful layout.
